annotation.title_clean: Artificial intelligence-related health research: ethics review and oversight
annotation.title_en: Artificial intelligence-related health research: ethics review and oversight
annotation.authors_or_issuer: World Health Organization (WHO Expert Group on Ethics and Governance of AI for Health)
annotation.summary_en: WHO report page on ethics review and oversight of AI-related health research, covering AI data science, research using AI tools, and research on AI tools. It identifies gaps in ethical standards and oversight, research ethics committee challenges, and LMIC risks such as data colonialism and ethics dumping.
key_provisions_or_claims: Existing oversight systems do not fully address novel risks of AI in health research
Analyses three categories of AI-related health research
Highlights LMIC inequities: data colonialism, ethics dumping, benefit sharing
Considers roles for funders, journals, regulators and data access mechanisms
Examines benefits and risks of using AI in ethics review
